payload.core_mechanism_summary: Two 1D DP arrays: dp[i] counts all paths summing to i with edges 1..k; dp2[i] counts paths using only edges < d. Subtract modulo MOD.
payload.rationale: The solution reduces the tree path counting to a classic 1D coin change DP. No tree-based recursion or memoization; simple iterative array updates indicate dp_1d_state.
